newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-MUSTER OUSTS IVANISEVIC AT OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MUSTER OUSTS IVANISEVIC AT OPEN.

text.p: Austrian fifth seed Thomas Muster brushed aside third seed Goran Ivanisevic of Croatia in straight sets to advance to the semifinals of the Australian Open on Wednesday.
Muster, who briefly held the number one spot in the world rankings last year, outplayed Ivanisevic from the baseline, winning 6-4 6-2 6-3 in one hour and 42 minutes.
The Austrian, who won the French Open two years ago, equalled his best performance in Melbourne following his semifinal effort in 1989.
Ivanisevic failed to find his serving rhythm and was cited for racquet abuse after slamming it into the court three times.
